ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher; not the driver's to retain. Record the driver's false no-show cancellation (claim of 5 min wait contradicted by GPS/timeline) against his cancellation record; driver already has 2 upheld no-show disputes in 90 d — monitor for repeated abuse.

rejected_claims.reason: Driver's claim of waiting at least 5 minutes at the pickup is contradicted by system records: cumulative time within 200 m was 2 min 50 s [F2] and cancellation occurred 2 min 50 s after recorded arrival [F5]. GPS/timeline override statements, so the no-show basis fails NS-1(iii).
Driver's chat 'I'm here' is a statement, not the app 'I'm Here' button required by NS-1(i); the timeline entry for the button is null/inconsistent [F7].
